stem: During an emergency response, the team leader assigns specific roles for airway management, compressions, medications, and documentation. Why is this structured assignment important?

options.A: It helps team members know their responsibilities and supports coordinated task completion
options.B: It intentionally keeps team members unaware of one another's responsibilities
options.C: It removes the need for communication or reassessment once roles are assigned
options.D: It is less effective than allowing everyone to perform whichever task they notice first

rationale: TeamSTEPPS identifies assigning tasks and responsibilities as a core team-leadership function. Effective leaders determine needed roles, allocate them appropriately, communicate clear expectations, and monitor progress. Clear role assignment therefore supports coordinated performance during complex, time-sensitive care.
educational_objective: Explain why clear role and task assignment supports coordinated team performance during an emergency.
source_organization: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)
source_document_title: TeamSTEPPS 3.0: Team Leadership Concepts and Tools
source_claim_supported: Supports identifying roles, allocating tasks, communicating expectations, and monitoring team progress.
correction_summary: Retained the emergency-team construct but grounded it in current TeamSTEPPS rather than a generic ACLS citation or unsupported outcome claim.
audit_findings: A directly reflects TeamSTEPPS; B-D undermine defined team structure and communication.
blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Management of Care, printed p.7 / PDF p.11
